title: Tensor and algebra adjunction for nonsymmetric operads
statement:
Use the universes and monoidal infinity categories of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and presentability of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Use ordinary small nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-nonsymmetric-operads-presentability]. For a small quasicategory $C$ and an operad $\mathcal O$, their categorical-pattern tensor $C\odot\mathcal O$ exists. It is the operadic fibrant replacement of the marked product $C\times\mathcal O\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, with edges marked when their $C$-component is an equivalence and their $\mathcal O$-component is inert. For an operad $\mathcal Q$, let $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal Q)$ be the full infinity category of functors $\mathcal O\to\mathcal Q$ over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ preserving inert edges. There are coherent natural equivalences
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Opd}^{\mathrm{ns}}_\infty}(C\odot\mathcal O,\mathcal Q)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Cat}_\infty}(C,\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal Q)).$$
The tensor preserves small colimits separately in $C$ and $\mathcal O$. The assertions hold under universe enlargement: inclusion of the operads small in one universe into operads small in a containing universe preserves colimits indexed by simplicial sets small in the first universe. The displayed equivalence and separate preservation of such colimits also hold with $C$ and $\mathcal Q$ in the containing universe, with $C\odot\mathcal O$ and the mapping spaces then formed there. Fibrant replacement means a weak-equivalence map to a fibrant object in the nonsymmetric-operad model structure, whose cofibrations are monomorphisms and fibrant marked objects are precisely operads with inert edges marked; different replacements give equivalent operads.
